source: Shipped location art (CardImageWarpData of the village inn interior cards), already an empty room, used as it is.
description: the village inn's common room: warm timber walls and a beamed ceiling, bundles of dried lavender and herbs hanging from the rafters beside a hanging iron lantern, a large stone fireplace on the right with an iron cauldron over a crackling fire, a back counter with stacked ale barrels and shelves of jugs and bottles, a small leaded window, long plank tables and benches with lanterns, pewter mugs and a loaf of bread, a round wooden stool, wide worn floorboards, amber firelight
notes: The plate is framed by an open doorway; a composition may bring the camera inside the room and drop the door frame. Shared by every character's Inn portrait (Miller, Weaver, Alchemist, Professor) so the room stays the same room.
